timing_policy: Four persistent isolated Python workers; GPU calls run sequentially. Each variant/operation receives continuous worker-local warmup, followed by alternating interleaved rounds with one synchronized timed call per variant. Starting order rotates across datasets and operations; every other round reverses it. No result caching or production hooks. Public validation, NumPy boundaries, and GPU synchronization are timed; every output is audited outside timing. Ratios are descriptive, not confidence bounds.
warmup_policy: Worker block warmup lasts at least the requested duration. Its one post-warmup sample is retained as a separately audited probe, excluded from paired ratios. All warmup audits and probe samples are preserved.
fit_query_policy: Every fit_query call constructs a new estimator and includes its first query and deferred preparation. kneighbors reuses the model established by cold.
cold_policy: First fit/query for each dataset in each persistent worker is reported separately and audited. Earlier datasets can populate Metal compilation caches.
accuracy_reference: Unchanged knn_pipeline fixture: sklearn brute float64 selects neighbors on serialized float32 inputs; selected distances are recomputed by direct float64 subtraction and sorted by distance/index.
acceptance_policy: Any cold, warmup, probe or retained accuracy failure, missing timed sample, worker error, or source/fixture/harness integrity failure produces exit status 1. Timing ratios and slowdowns never change the numerical oracle or hide failed samples.
